projects.title: RuangRapi
projects.short: Rental operations SaaS for Indonesian landlords.
projects.description: An operations system for owners of kos, kontrakan and small apartment portfolios: units, tenants, leases, monthly billing, payments, receipts, WhatsApp reminders, utility readings and maintenance tickets. Built as a modular monolith on Supabase with row-level security, specified domain-first and developed in small, reviewable agent-assisted steps.

projects.title: This Flight-Sim CV
projects.short: The 3D portfolio you are flying through right now.
projects.description: The real Solar System in React Three Fiber, every planet on its NASA JPL orbit for the date shown, with a chase-cam flight model, probe dossiers you grab with a tractor beam and a HUD that updates without React re-renders. Models are generated by scripted Blender and compressed with gltf-transform; behaviour is pinned by unit tests and end-to-end probes that drive a real Chrome, including draw-call and shader-program budgets.

projects.title: fuxx
projects.short: GPU-accelerated terminal for running AI coding agents.
projects.description: A native terminal that runs several AI coding agents in one window. Each session shows whether its agent is working, done or waiting for input, with a status badge and a desktop notification when a background session needs attention — so you can step away instead of watching a wall of terminals. Early and in active development, macOS first.
